record.paper_title: Некоторые экстремальные задачи для векторных расслоений
record.original_question: For the tautological bundle γ^n_k, is it true that every continuous field of centrally symmetric k-dimensional convex polytopes in γ^n_k contains at least one polytope with at least 2n vertices? The case k=2 is established; the question remains in the general bundle setting.

evidence.quote: Гипотеза 2. Всякое п.ц.-с.м. в расслоении γnk содержит многогранники с c ≥ 2n вершинами.
Для этого случая мы докажем гипотезу 2, а также докажем утверждение, близкое к гипотезе 1.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\gamma^n_k$ denote the tautological rank-$k$ vector bundle over the real Grassmannian $G(k,n)$ of $k$-dimensional linear subspaces of $\mathbb{R}^n$; its total space is $\{(L,v) : L \in G(k,n),\ v \in L\}$, with fiber $\gamma^n_k|_L = L$. A continuous field of centrally symmetric $k$-dimensional convex polytopes in $\gamma^n_k$ is an assignment $L \mapsto P(L)$ where $P(L) \subset \gamma^n_k|_L = L$ is a centrally symmetric (i.e., $P(L) = -P(L)$) convex polytope of full dimension $k$ in $L$, depending continuously on $L \in G(k,n)$ (continuity in the Hausdorff metric on compact convex subsets of fibers).

Prove or disprove: for every such continuous field $L \mapsto P(L)$, there exists at least one $L \in G(k,n)$ such that the polytope $P(L)$ has at least $2n$ vertices.
artifact.category_tag: Convex polytope fields on vector bundles
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture is stated as open in general, with the case $k=2$ established. No subsequent publication confirming a full proof for general $k$ was located, so the general case appears still open.

status_evidence.title: Some extremal problems for vector bundles (zbMATH entry)
status_evidence.snippet: Conjecture states every continuous field of centrally symmetric polytopes in γ^n_k contains a polytope with ≥ 2n vertices; the case k=2 is proved.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture is open in general; k=2 is proved.
